decision.covered_scope: Removal of non-owned flood-borne debris (stones) from underneath the insured building to the perimeter of the building.
decision.evidence_needed: Additional evidence that the contractor's estimated dollar amount is limited to the covered scope of work; other debris removal estimates from one or more different contractors to verify pricing is reasonable and customary for the location and site conditions.
decision.excluded_scope: Transportation by barge, handling, disposal, and yard work components outside the building's perimeter footprint.
decision.prior_claim_check: Before issuing any additional payment for the subject July 2019 flood event, the insurer should verify that debris removal for the same area underneath the building was performed before the July 2019 flood event; retain proof of repairs and pricing from previous losses to prevent payment overlap

findings.evidence: SFIP covers expense to remove non-owned debris on or in insured property; engineer confirmed 12 to 15 cubic yards of stones under the building.
findings.title: Coverage for Under-Building Debris Removal

findings.evidence: SFIP excludes costs for barge transportation, handling, and disposal as these are not part of removing debris from insured property.
findings.title: Exclusion of Transport and Disposal Costs

findings.evidence: Contractor quote of $3,564 per cubic yard requires validation against other estimates to ensure reasonableness.
findings.title: Validation of Removal Pricing

findings.evidence: Before issuing any additional payment for the subject July 2019 flood event, the insurer should verify that debris removal for the same area underneath the building was performed before the July 2019 flood event; retain proof of repairs and pricing from previous losses to prevent payment overlap
findings.title: Verification of Prior Claim Activity
